tools.name: generate-area-map
tools.description: Generates regional distribution maps, which are usually used to show the administrative divisions and coverage of a dataset. It is not suitable for showing the distribution of specific locations, such as urban administrative divisions, GDP distribution maps of provinces and cities across the country, etc. This tool is limited to generating data maps within China.

title.description: The map title should not exceed 16 characters. The content should be consistent with the information the map wants to convey and should be accurate, rich, creative, and attractive.

name.description: In Chinese, the keywords for administrative divisions must be within China, and can only be China, provinces, cities, districts and counties, and cannot be specific place names.

fillColor.description: Fill color, rgb or rgba format.

colors.description: Data color list, in rgb or rgba format.

dataType.description: The type of the data value, numeric or enumeration type

dataValue.description: Data value, numeric string or enumeration string.
Data value, numeric string or enumeration string.

subdistricts.description: Sub-administrative regions are used to display the regional composition or regional distribution of related data.

data.description: Administrative division data, lower-level administrative divisions are optional. There are usually two scenarios: one is to simply display the regional composition, only `fillColor` needs to be configured, and all administrative divisions are consistent, representing that all blocks are connected as one; the other is the regional data distribution scenario, first determine the `dataType` and `dataLabel` configurations, `dataValue` should be a meaningful value and consistent with the meaning of dataType, and then determine the style configuration. The `fillColor` configuration represents the default fill color for areas without data. Lower-level administrative divisions do not need `fillColor` configuration, and their fill colors are determined by the `colors` configuration (If `dataType` is "number", only one base color (warm color) is needed in the list to calculate the continuous data mapping color band; if `dataType` is "enum", the number of color values ​​​​in the list is equal to the number of enumeration values ​​(contrast colors).). If `subdistricts` has a value, it is recommended to set `showAllSubdistricts` to true, and if the current administrative region is China, `showAllSubdistricts` must be set to true.

width.description: Set the width of map. There is a default value, unless explicitly specified, otherwise no.

height.description: Set the height of map. There is a default value, unless explicitly specified, otherwise no.

tools.name: generate-path-map
tools.description: Generate a route map to display the user's planned route, such as travel guide routes.

title.description: The map title should not exceed 16 characters. The content should be consistent with the information the map wants to convey and should be accurate, rich, creative, and attractive.

items.description: In Chinese, keywords of the name of a place in China, and describe it more specifically, such as adding some attributive descriptions of the place in front.

data.description: A list of POI names. The tool will use these names as keywords to get detailed data, such as latitude and longitude, location photos, etc. In addition, this should usually be a group of places with similar locations, so the name should be more descriptive, for example "Xi'an Bell Tower" is better than "Bell Tower"

items.description: The route and places along it.

data.description: Routes, each group represents all POIs along a route.

width.description: Set the width of map. There is a default value, unless explicitly specified, otherwise no.

height.description: Set the height of map. There is a default value, unless explicitly specified, otherwise no.

tools.name: generate-pin-map
tools.description: Generate a point map to display the location and distribution of point data on the map, such as the location distribution of attractions, hospitals, supermarkets, etc.

title.description: The map title should not exceed 16 characters. The content should be consistent with the information the map wants to convey and should be accurate, rich, creative, and attractive.

items.description: In Chinese, keywords of the name of a place in China, and describe it more specifically, such as adding some attributive descriptions of the place in front.

data.description: A list of POI names. The tool will use these names as keywords to get detailed data, such as latitude and longitude, location photos, etc. In addition, this should usually be a group of places with similar locations, so the name should be more descriptive, for example "Xi'an Bell Tower" is better than "Bell Tower"

markerPopup.description: Marker type, one is simple mode, which is just an icon and does not require `markerPopup` configuration; the other is image mode, which displays location photos and requires `markerPopup` configuration. Among them, `width`/`height`/`borderRadius` can be combined to realize rectangular photos and square photos. In addition, when `borderRadius` is half of the width and height, it can also be a circular photo.

width.description: Set the width of map. There is a default value, unless explicitly specified, otherwise no.

height.description: Set the height of map. There is a default value, unless explicitly specified, otherwise no.
